title: Tool Wear Inspection and Classiﬁcation by Artiﬁcial Neural Network Based on Vision System and Cutting Force Signal.
summary: A feed-forward neural network classified milling tools as normal or worn from cutting-force features; machine-vision measurements supplied tool-wear observations for the reported manufacturing-monitoring experiment. Validation was limited to the tested setup.
ai_technology: Feed-forward neural network classifier using cutting-force features, with tool-wear observations from machine vision.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.unknown: Validation is confined to the reported milling setup; broader operational generalization was not established.
